topic: ClickHouse logging and disk space issues
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on diagnosing severe disk space limitations affecting the ClickHouse instance. [me] noted that while one partition had sufficient free space, another was critically low. The primary concern was excessive logging activity in `/var/log/clickhouse-server/` and general system logs (`/var/log/messages`). It was discussed whether it was possible to limit or control the amount of data logged by ClickHouse.
decisions: No concrete decisions were made regarding disk space allocation.
action_items: Investigate methods to reduce logging volume for ClickHouse.
